analysis: Examined ClusterOnboardingLive.swift head lines 1-915. Changes visible: new closures stopsAsked/serveUnlessStopped (head 77-78); execute() now routes status replies through followerStatus adding start progress and stopsAsked counter (399-408); forwarded .serve passes request.stopsBefore into localServe(unlessStoppedSince:) and .stop calls localStop(asked: true) (464-465). These are cluster-pair control-channel semantics over the already-authenticated paired link (command() over link key, per otherMacAnswers comment line 269). The paired peer could send stopsBefore to suppress a serve, or stop requests, but it could already send serve/stop before this PR, so no new privilege. The stopsAsked count added to status replies exposes only a counter to the paired peer. Implementations of localServe(unlessStoppedSince:), localStop(asked:), currentStopsAsked and stopsAsked are in other changed ranges (head 1459+, 2238+, 2377+, 2573+) not in this batch; integration should check they validate stopsBefore (e.g. no unbounded/time-trusting logic that lets a peer permanently block serving, A-018 availability) and that the stop-count record is bounded and owner-only. No threat-model assets (A-001 prompts, keys, attestation) are touched in the visible units; no T-041 cache interaction found.
